name: Last Orders
choreography: Deep hip coil into the largest rising uppercut on first active; recoil into a second compact rising strike at43, weave beneath the descending target, headbutt at74 and a final committed forehead strike at96; settle into Dempsey guard.
requirements: Fixed muscular anatomy, staff secured behind his back
Largest limb travel between last startup and first active
Headbutts use forehead, no extra limbs or floating weapon
Hit finishes in Dempsey; block/miss recover normally
Native hit, mirrored, block and whiff
Four separate staff-return recovery keys for block and whiff
